message: Removed help text that only repeated the name of a setting, such as the line under Author on a recipe or the “Nothing in the app vibrates” under Haptic feedback, and shortened some of the rest. The task editor’s Location row now says it adds a directions button, and six tips now say where to find what they describe. VoiceOver hints now say what a control does instead of “Double tap to…”, and are left out where the label already says it.
